name: He Songyuan
source:
Identity: Tourist
Occupation: A technician at a certain company, a liaison officer for a certain mountaineering organisation.
Character: Distrustful and pessimistic, keeps everyone at arm's length, and enjoys taunting and provoking people for no reason.
Dream: None
Experience: He has worked in an oppressive environment for a long time, and enjoys speaking of apocalypses. Despite that, his technical flair is indisputable.
Why he is here: The CEO of his company went on an unexpected holiday, and his short temper was proving destructive to his team's efficiency.
